58773-les-machines.title: Les Machines
58773-les-machines.creator: Unknown
58773-les-machines.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Watson, servant of Arnaud d'Larte, called us at nine five P.M. Her master was dead, she said. When we answered her call we found Mr. d'Larte's body in his bedroom. He had been dead for about an hour."

arxiv-1811-01303.title: Space-Time Sampling for Network Observability
arxiv-1811-01303.creator: Hossein K. Mousavi, Qiyu Sun, Nader Motee
arxiv-1811-01303.description: Abstract Designing sparse sampling strategies is one of the important components in having resilient estimation and control in networked systems as they make network design problems more cost-effective due to their reduced sampling requirements and less fragile to where and when samples are collected.

arxiv-2111-11139.title: Sublinear quantum algorithms for estimating von Neumann entropy
arxiv-2111-11139.creator: Tom Gur, Min-Hsiu Hsieh, Sathyawageeswar Subramanian
arxiv-2111-11139.description: Abstract Abstract Entropy is a fundamental property of both classical and quantum systems, spanning myriad theoretical and practical applications in physics and computer science. We study the problem of obtaining estimates to within a multiplicative factor γ > 1 \gamma>1 of the Shannon entropy of probability distributions and the von Neumann entropy of mixed quantum states.

arxiv-2211-02969.title: MEGADES: MEGARA galaxy disc evolution survey
arxiv-2211-02969.creator: M. Chamorro-Cazorla, A. Gil de Paz, Á. Castillo-Morales, J. Gallego, E. Carrasco, J. Iglesias-Páramo, M. L. García-Vargas, S. Pascual, N. Cardiel, C. Catalán-Torrecilla, J. Zamorano, P. Sánchez-Blázquez, A. Pérez-Calpena, P. Gómez-Álvarez, J. Jiménez-Vicente
arxiv-2211-02969.description: Abstract The main interest of the science team for the exploitation of the MEGARA instrument at the 10.4m Gran Telescopio Canarias (GTC hereafter) is devoted to the study of nearby galaxies. The focus lies on researching the history of star formation, and the chemical and kinematical properties of disc systems.

arxiv-2303-00866.title: A prototype hybrid prediction market for estimating replicability of published work
arxiv-2303-00866.creator: Tatiana Chakravorti, Robert Fraleigh, Timothy Fritton, Michael McLaughlin, Vaibhav Singh, Christopher Griffin, Anthony Kwasnica, David Pennock, C. Lee Giles, Sarah Rajtmajer
arxiv-2303-00866.description: Abstract We present a prototype hybrid prediction market and demonstrate the avenue it represents for meaningful human-AI collaboration. We build on prior work proposing artificial prediction markets as a novel machine learning algorithm. In an artificial prediction market, trained AI agents (bot traders) buy and sell outcomes of future events.

arxiv-2303-14544.title: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies in Federated Learning for the Internet of Healthcare Things: A Survey Thanks:
arxiv-2303-14544.creator: Fatemeh Mosaiyebzadeh 1 , Seyedamin Pouriyeh 2 , Reza M. Parizi 3 , Quan Z. Sheng 4 , Meng Han 5 , Liang Zhao 2 , Giovanna Sannino 6 , Daniel Macêdo Batista 1
arxiv-2303-14544.description: Abstract Advancements in wearable medical devices in IoT technology are shaping the modern healthcare system. With the emergence of the Internet of Healthcare Things (IoHT), we are witnessing how efficient healthcare services are provided to patients and how healthcare professionals are effectively used AI-based models to analyze the data collected from IoHT devices for the treatment of various diseases.

arxiv-2312-15211.title: MACE-OFF: Short Range Transferable Machine Learning Force Fields for Organic Molecules
arxiv-2312-15211.creator: Dávid Péter Kovács *, J. Harry Moore *, Nicholas J. Browning, Ilyes Batatia, Joshua T. Horton, Yixuan Pu, Venkat Kapil, William C. Witt, Ioan-Bogdan Magdău, Daniel J. Cole, Gábor Csányi
arxiv-2312-15211.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dávid Péter Kovács *, J. Harry Moore *, Nicholas J. Browning, Ilyes Batatia, Joshua T. Horton, Yixuan Pu, Venkat Kapil, William C. Witt, Ioan-Bogdan Magdău, Daniel J. Cole, Gábor Csányi. Classical empirical force fields have dominated biomolecular simulation for over 50 years. Although widely used in drug discovery, crystal structure prediction, and biomolecular dynamics, they generally lack the accuracy and transferability required for first-principles predictive modeling.

arxiv-2401-11986.title: Versatile quadrature antenna for precise control of large electron spin ensembles in diamond
arxiv-2401-11986.creator: Ruben Pellicer-Guridi, Koen Custers, Joseba Solozabal-Aldalur, Alexey Brodolin, Jason T. Francis, Miguel Varga, Jorge Casanova, Margarethus M. Paulides, Gabriel Molina-Terriza
arxiv-2401-11986.description: Abstract We present an easily reproducible inexpensive microwave antenna that can generate a strong and homogeneous magnetic field of arbitrary polarization, which enables fast and coherent control of electron spins over a large volume. Unlike preceding works, we present a resonant antenna that maintains its resonant behaviour regardless of the proximity of other experimental hardware components.

arxiv-2403-16211.title: Chandra and HST studies of the X-ray sources in the Globular Cluster NGC 362
arxiv-2403-16211.creator: Gourav Kumawat, Craig O. Heinke, Haldan N. Cohn, Phyllis M. Lugger
arxiv-2403-16211.description: Abstract We analyse a Chandra observation of the rich globular cluster NGC 362, finding 33 X-ray sources within 1’ (1.2 half-mass radii) of the cluster center. Spectral analysis of the brightest source (X1) shows blackbody-like emission, indicating it is likely a quiescent low-mass X-ray binary; we find a possible counterpart that falls in the sub-subgiant region.

arxiv-2406-04231.title: Quantifying Misalignment Between Agents: Towards a Sociotechnical Understanding of Alignment
arxiv-2406-04231.creator: Aidan Kierans, Avijit Ghosh, Hananel Hazan, Shiri Dori-Hacohen
arxiv-2406-04231.description: Abstract Existing work on the alignment problem has focused mainly on (1) qualitative descriptions of the alignment problem; (2) attempting to align AI actions with human interests by focusing on value specification and learning; and/or (3) focusing on a single agent or on humanity as a monolith.

arxiv-2409-06454.title: Kerr Black hole mimickers sourced by a string fluid
arxiv-2409-06454.creator: Ram Brustein, A.J.M. Medved, Tamar Simhon, ramyb@bgu.ac.il, j.medved@ru.ac.za, simhot@post.bgu.ac.il
arxiv-2409-06454.description: Abstract We present rotating solutions of Einstein’s gravity coupled to an effective Born-Infeld theory that describes the end of open-string tachyon condensation after the decay of an unstable D D -brane or a brane-antibrane system. The geometry of these solutions is that of the rotating frozen star.

arxiv-2411-07159.title: Probing nuclear structure and the equation of state through pre-equilibrium dipole emission in charge-asymmetric reactions
arxiv-2411-07159.creator: L. Shvedov, S. Burrello, M. Colonna, H. Zheng
arxiv-2411-07159.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by L. Shvedov, S. Burrello, M. Colonna, H. Zheng. We investigate the pre-equilibrium dipole response in the charge-asymmetric reaction 40 Ca + 152 Sm, of recent experimental interest, at several beam energies within the range [ 5 , 11 ] [5,11] AMeV and different collision centralities. By employing Skyrme-like effective interactions for the nuclear mean field, we probe the role of the different ingredients performing theoretical calculations based on the time-dependent Hartree-Fock approach or a semi-classical transport model that also includes two-body correlations.

arxiv-2504-10509.title: Beyond Reproducibility: Advancing Zero-shot LLM Reranking Efficiency with Setwise Insertion
arxiv-2504-10509.creator: Jakub Podolak, Leon Perić, Mina Janićijević, Roxana Petcu
arxiv-2504-10509.description: Abstract . This study presents a comprehensive reproducibility analysis and extension of the Setwise prompting method for zero-shot ranking with Large Language Models (LLMs), as proposed by Zhuang et al. (2024) . We evaluate the method’s effectiveness and efficiency compared to traditional Pointwise, Pairwise, and Listwise approaches in document ranking tasks. Our reproduction confirms the findings of Zhuang et al.

arxiv-2512-05528.title: Decoding Selective Auditory Attention to Musical Elements in Ecologically Valid Music Listening
arxiv-2512-05528.creator: Taketo Akama, Zhuohao Zhang, Tsukasa Nagashima, Takagi Yutaka, Shun Minamikawa, Natalia Polouliakh
arxiv-2512-05528.description: Abstract Art has long played a profound role in shaping human emotion, cognition, and behavior. While visual arts such as painting and architecture have been studied through eye-tracking, revealing distinct gaze patterns between experts and novices, analogous methods for auditory art forms remain underdeveloped.

arxiv-2601-09189.title: Experimental verification of the conservation of the magnetic moment and the longitudinal invariant
arxiv-2601-09189.creator: Juan Carlos Agurto, Felipe Darmazo, Amanda Guerra, Erick Burgos-Parra
arxiv-2601-09189.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Juan Carlos Agurto, Felipe Darmazo, Amanda Guerra, Erick Burgos-Parra. Adiabatic invariants are fundamental to plasma physics but are often treated as purely theoretical concepts in undergraduate courses due to the difficulty of experimentally demonstrating them. This paper presents a pedagogical experiment to visualize and quantitatively verify the conservation of the magnetic moment ( μ \mu ) and the longitudinal invariant ( J J ) using a standard educational electron charge-to-mass ratio apparatus configured as a magnetic bottle.

To better understand the impact of the pandemic on childhood routine immunisation, we estimated disruptions in vaccine coverage associated with the pa

pmc-10570044.title: PAXIP1 and STAG2 converge to maintain 3D genome architecture and facilitate promoter/enhancer contacts to enable stress hormone-dependent transcription
pmc-10570044.creator: Isabel Mayayo-Peralta, Sebastian Gregoricchio, Karianne Schuurman, Selçuk Yavuz, Anniek Zaalberg, Aleksandar Kojic, Nina Abbott, Bart Geverts, Suzanne Beerthuijzen, Joseph Siefert, Tesa M Severson, Martijn van Baalen, Liesbeth Hoekman, Cor Lieftink, Maarten Altelaar, Roderick L Beijersbergen, Adriaa
pmc-10570044.description: How steroid hormone receptors (SHRs) regulate transcriptional activity remains partly understood. Upon activation, SHRs bind the genome together with a co-regulator repertoire, crucial to induce gene expression. However, it remains unknown which components of the SHR-recruited co-regulator complex are essential to drive transcription following hormonal stimuli. Through a FACS-based genome-wide CRISPR screen, we functionally dissected the Glucocorticoid Receptor (GR) complex.

pmc-11635090.title: Mechanisms governing bystander activation of T cells
pmc-11635090.creator: Mohammed Yosri, Mohamed Dokhan, Elizabeth Aboagye, Mouhamad Al Moussawy, Hossam A. Abdelsamed
pmc-11635090.description: The immune system is endowed with the capacity to distinguish between self and non-self, so-called immune tolerance or “consciousness of the immune system.” This type of awareness is designed to achieve host protection by eliminating cells expressing a wide range of non-self antigens including microbial-derived peptides.

pmc-11698561.title: Local chemotherapy with conjunctival bevacizumab injections in case of lymphoma tumor
pmc-11698561.creator: Piotr Fryczkowski
pmc-11698561.description: e lymphoma (MZL). They are three types of MZL: extranodal, nodal, and splenic. Extranodal MZL, or mucosa associated lymphoid tissue (MALT), is the most common form of MZL. It occurs more commonly in women at the average age of 60 years.

pmc-12515432.title: Exploring phytochemicals as potential pharmacological inhibitors for NS1 protein of Kyasanur forest disease virus using virtual screening, molecular docking, and molecular simulation approach
pmc-12515432.creator: Sharanappa Achappa, Nayef Abdulaziz Aldabaan, Ibrahim Ahmed Shaikh, Mater H. Mahnashi, Shivalingsarj V. Desai, Mufarreh Asmari, Mohammed Alasmary, Uday M. Muddapur, Basheerahmed Abdulaziz Mannasaheb, Aejaz Abdullatif Khan
pmc-12515432.description: BackgroundKyasanur forest disease virus (KFDV) remains a significant public health challenge due to the limitations of existing vaccines, creating a critical need for effective antiviral treatments. KFDV is a tick-borne virus responsible for 400–500 new cases annually, with a mortality rate of 3–5%.

pmc-12571993.title: Impact of Age on Early CAR T‐Cell Therapy Toxicity: A Propensity Score Matching Analysis
pmc-12571993.creator: Jia Yi Tan, Yong‐Hao Yeo, Qi Xuan Ang, George Chen, Kok Hoe Chan
pmc-12571993.description: IntroductionDespite the growing use of CAR‐T therapy, adults over 65 still receive this treatment less frequently than younger patients.MethodsUsing the Nationwide Readmissions Database (2018–2020), we analyzed 2928 CAR‐T recipients, dividing them into young (18–40), middle‐aged (41–65), and older adults (≥ 66). Propensity score matching (caliper of 0.2, 1:1:1 ratio) was performed.

pmc-12659482.title: Effects of different bupivacaine concentrations with dural puncture epidural technique for labor analgesia: a prospective randomized controlled trial
pmc-12659482.creator: Fatma Pınar Uçar, Hande Güngör Danışan, Burak Ömür, Haci Ahmet Alıcı, Pelin Karaaslan
pmc-12659482.description: BackgroundDural puncture epidural (DPE) is a newer and more advantageous method in labor analgesia. It provides a faster analgesia onset and higher-quality block compared to the conventional epidural (CE) method, while causing fewer adverse effects than the combined spinal-epidural (CSE) technique.

pmc-13083381.title: Evaluation of sample preparation methods for NMR-based metabolomics of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) ovarian fluid
pmc-13083381.creator: Fabio Casu, Amanda L. Bayless, Brian C. Peterson, Heather J. Hamlin, Ashley S. P. Boggs, Tracey B. Schock
pmc-13083381.description: Average embryo survival in farmed Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) has declined sharply from about 80% to below 50% in North America over the past two decades. The underlying causes remain unclear, and no effective solutions currently exist for this problem, posing a major challenge to the production of a leading aquaculture species in the USA.

pmc-13468359.title: Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation: A Review of Architectures, Adaptations, and Prospects
pmc-13468359.creator: Ming Deng, Yongyi Chen, Guanghai Ding, Shuiwang Li, Xiaolan Xie

pmc-13539707.title: Comment - Louis XIV’s terminal illness clinical chronology favors necrotizing soft-tissue infection
pmc-13539707.creator: Alexis Demas
pmc-13539707.description: Louis XIV’s rapidly progressive terminal illness may be better explained by necrotizing soft-tissue infection than primary calciphylaxis. Severe distal pain, ascending gangrene, and fatal sepsis within three weeks suggest fulminant infection, plausibly arising from a diabetic foot lesion. Clinical chronology should remain central when evaluating competing retrospective clinicopathological hypotheses.
